notes.title: Store Page Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372617/75b462142741570909feaa6205024f564ea6ce76.png[/img]

-Created a new game trailer that accurately reflects the Future Weapon Experience.
-Added Online level changing support
       -We can finally have multiple levels
-Added 3 variations of Earth and Moon Level
-PVP is available on level 3
-Added Initial cutscene in level one
-Added 4 camera modes
         ___Free Rotating
         ___Combat
         ___Classic(2D top down)/Non Rotating
         ___Left Behind/Frozen Camera
                ___ its gonna need a better name
-Added tons of 3D Models and spaceships.
-Revamped UI
-Added Prism Menace NPCs

Warning
       Known bug where ships you craft do not get transported to the next level.
       Fear not, I know exactly where the bug is and how to solve it.
       Will probably be fixed by the time you read this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372617/7ca04eabcd4b3134f576551edd9df5ebf839aa3c.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372617/78cc0d6d49415d1709992f2942bacf2d91fdf3ff.png[/img]

Patch Notes(Demo)
~Removed most AI art from the Game reducing ram consumption and saving disk space
~All vehicles and structures are now using the Same tile map system
~Added 2 New Levels, Andari I & Andari II
~Made tutorials less of a data dump
~Characters no longer talk every time you move, very annoying
~Added a new weapon, Heavy Gauss Gun
~Cleaner UI
~Health bars are now physically attached on vehicles like in Dead Space
~Nerfed the Missile Launcher
~Demo can now save because why not . . . But don't cry if things get deleted later
~made added 2 original sound tracks
~Fixed a bug where passengers couldn't exit passenger seats

Thank you for playing my demo,
I will be making many more levels for you to enjoy with your friends!
